****_Superman_ (Volume 3) #39**** is an issue of the series [_Superman_ (Volume 3)](https://dc.fandom.com/wiki/Superman_Vol_3 "Superman Vol 3") with a cover date of [May, 2015](https://dc.fandom.com/wiki/Category:2015,_May "Category:2015, May"). It was published on March 18, 2015.

## Synopsis for "24 Hours"

In [Kansas City](https://dc.fandom.com/wiki/Kansas_City "Kansas City"), a woman named Janet delivers a package into a mailbox, and calls back to her employer to report on her activities.

Meanwhile, in [Metropolis](https://dc.fandom.com/wiki/Metropolis "Metropolis"), [Clark Kent](https://dc.fandom.com/wiki/Superman_(Clark_Kent) "Superman (Clark Kent)") has just revealed to his friend [Jimmy Olsen](https://dc.fandom.com/wiki/James_Olsen_(Prime_Earth) "James Olsen (Prime Earth)") that he and Superman are one and the same. Jimmy doubts it, but Clark insists that it's true - only he's lost his powers for the time being, and he's had to get a new suit. His ability to release a flare of solar energy had destroyed the old one and depleted his strength. and though he expects to recharge soon, he worries that the new ability is _dangerous_. In the meantime, as a human, Clark is actually feeling _cold_ for once. He has to use his super-vision to _see_ the air density, and determine how to dress appropriately to fool others. While walking through the park, he and Jimmy spot a kid trying to get to a stuck kite in a tree, but he seems like he'll fall. Hurriedly, Clark leaps out to catch him, and injures his arm. Though he is okay, Jimmy warns him that he has to be _careful_ today, noting that they'll be late for their staff meeting at the [Daily Planet](https://dc.fandom.com/wiki/Daily_Planet "Daily Planet") if they don't hurry.
